notes.title: Rebuild
notes.content:
Hi guys.

Sorry for no update long time. I am rebuilding the game because I want to add more features. There will be more guns, more mods, and some sort of economics (no microtransactions).

notes.title: Version 0.5.2 Update
notes.content:
Hello dizzies.

New update is available. 

* Added more options for sounds/music
* Timosad map changes
* Vertigo map changes
* Added jumping
* AI improvement

Other small fixes and performance fixes.
